exclusions.reason: SLAP2 stimulus table lacks protocol block 9

method.aggregation: Session metrics are arithmetic means within each mouse and context; each mouse contributes one plotted value per context.
method.binning: Velocity is integrated to position and differenced in non-overlapping 50 ms bins; SLAP2 encoder position is calibrated before differencing.
method.block_comparison: Context means use the context-specific 26-minute block. Control means pool standard, standard-repeat, sequence, jitter, and open-loop blocks; natural-movie and receptive-field blocks are excluded.
method.forward_speed: Negative velocity is set to zero before summarization.
method.profile: Example profiles average forward speed in 5-second bins over measured protocol-block boundaries.
method.running_fraction: Fraction of 50 ms bins with forward speed above 1 cm/s.
method.scope: Finite running samples within measured protocol blocks.
